hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Mixpad token launchpad. Collects platform swap fees on every trade and splits them between the token creator and a treasury. Applies a decaying anti-snipe surcharge on buys in the first N blocks post-launch and a time-limited deployer-dump surcharge on sells. Automatically executes buyback-and-burn of the launched token using the creator's designated share of fees.
